evidence: core/CandleProcessor.js:1020-1028 constructs t and etime on every streamed candle

core/StrategyOrchestrator.js:1018-1020 forwards that complete candle to MTF ingestion
modules/MultiTimeframeAdapter.js:159 preserves candle fields; 189-199 replaces equal t/etime instead of appending
